summary: Many community.windows modules such as win_audit_policy_system, win_credential, win_dns_record and win_dns_zone are deprecated and redirect to ansible.windows, with redirects removed in 4.0.0.
questions: Should I use community.windows.win_dns_record or ansible.windows.win_dns_record?
When will community.windows redirects be removed?

answer_card.title: community.windows modules moving to ansible.windows (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
These are deprecated and redirect to `ansible.windows.<same name>`. Update FQCNs; the redirects are removed in **community.windows 4.0.0**:

`win_audit_policy_system`, `win_audit_rule`, `win_auto_logon`, `win_certificate_info`, `win_computer_description`, `win_credential`, `win_dhcp_lease`, `win_dns_record`, `win_dns_zone`, `win_eventlog`.
